image_review.finding: Across these three selected planes there is no obvious gross translation, axis flip or scale mismatch between MRI and projected source masks. Red source tumor intersects public support boundaries/zero regions; blue automatic ventricular regions overlap visible internal fluid-like regions. This limited visual check does not establish segmentation accuracy, whole-volume anatomical coverage or clinical registration.
image_review.selection: Tumor source-grid center, evaluation-only; not actor observations.

public_support_ventricular_cue.consequence: Declare original support as informative public input. It is not a ventricular-hidden condition: 92.013% of source ventricular positives occupy public zeros. Any zero is nonspecific: only 2.108% of public zeros are source ventricular positives. Enclosed/open connectivity was not measured; no support modifications were made.

reference_conflict.consequence: Treat overlapping source annotations explicitly. Full tumor removal and zero intersection with every ventricular-reference voxel are mutually incompatible if both are hard constraints.

target_support.consequence: A simulator allowing removal only at support-positive voxels cannot reach all source whole-tumor positives. Preserve this denominator and failure, or define a narrower task explicitly; do not silently clip targets or fill support using private labels.

retained_uncertainties: Prior resection-cavity annotation exists but its payload is excluded; public support zeros are not proven empty or safely traversable tissue.

Target and ventricle labels retain finite source-grid domains; padded zeros outside those domains remain unknown. Cerebrum positives touch the crop boundary; the cropped support is not complete head or instrument-access geometry.
All SEG objects lack explicit source SOP references. Shared frame/source description and submillimeter numerical correspondence support this geometry check; no new registration is claimed.
Source documentation places these annotations preoperatively during planning; exact acquisition times and expert review of automatic masks are unknown.
Vessels, functional anatomy, patient-specific mechanics and clinical outcomes are not established.
review_scope: Saved source-bound JSON, native crop and label/domain arrays streamed by x-plane, and three local orthogonal overlays. No source DICOM reopens, source pixel redecodes or full-volume allocations.
suitable_scope: A geometric planning pilot against explicitly declared source annotations, with automatic Brainlab cerebrum supplied as public estimated support. Whole-tumor annotation can be designated as a research task target explicitly; it is not a source surgical prescription. Automatic ventricles can be a source-reference overlap endpoint, not independent manual truth or injury.
